userGoal: A player double-taps the arena to mark an orbital strike, confirms it, yields the turn, and the missile impacts only after the opponent turn ends.
inScope: Simulation state for a pending orbital target and deferred strike.
No held weapon and no generic aim requirement for orbital rocket.
Arena double-tap marker and confirmation flow.
One falling missile visual and explosion after the opponent handoff.
completionCriteria: Orbital rocket cannot use the generic projectile fallback.
The confirmed target does not damage units during the firing turn.
The impact fires after the opponent turn completes and uses the configured damage and radius.
Cancelling before confirmation removes the draft marker without consuming the action.
prohibitedTestWeakening: Do not replace the turn lifecycle with a direct impact helper.
Do not assert only a private pending flag.
